reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream 60g
reviews.text: I love this moisturizer and Im using all the some by mi miracle set the toner, serum, moisturizer and the toner pads. I would say everything works amazing on my skin. Im a user since 2020. Will keep purchasing since olive young is global now.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款面霜，some by mi 成個 miracle set 我都用緊，包括爽膚水、精華、面霜同爽膚水棉片。可以咁講，所有嘢用喺我塊面效果都好好。我由 2020 年開始用，會一直回購，而家 olive young 已經做全球配送。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream 60g
reviews.text:
I've been using AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream for over a year, and it's one of the few creams that I really want to come back to. 💚
I really like how the cream helps with breakouts, evens out the skin texture, and doesn't dry out the skin. My skin has become noticeably clearer, calmer, and smoother. It's especially effective in treating post-acne and minor blemishes. The texture is light, absorbs quickly, doesn't leave a sticky feeling, and works well for both daytime and evening skincare. I've also noticed that if I apply the cream before applying foundation, the foundation applies perfectly, leaving my skin looking smoother, more even, and well-groomed. ✨

After using it for a long time, my skin hasn't become accustomed to it, and the results remain consistent. For problematic and combination skin, this is a game-changer. It's definitely one of the best creams in my skincare routine!
reviews.zh:
我用 AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream 已經超過一年，係少數我真係會想回購嘅面霜之一。💚
我好鍾意呢款面霜幫我處理暗瘡、均勻膚質，又唔會抽乾皮膚水分。我塊面明顯清澈咗、穩定咗、幼滑咗。佢對處理暗瘡印同小瑕疵特別有效。質地輕薄，快吸收，唔黐笠，日頭同夜晚護膚都啱用。我仲留意到如果喺搽粉底之前用，粉底會好貼，皮膚望落更滑、更均勻、更整齊。✨

用咗咁耐，皮膚都冇產生抗藥性，效果一直保持穩定。對問題肌同混合性肌嚟講，呢款係 game-changer。絕對係我護膚程序入面最好嘅面霜之一！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream 60g
reviews.text: One of my favorites. Been a staple in my nighttime routine for almost a year now. Has helped with pores and reduced my breakouts. I don't do well with super heavy creams but don't want something light for my nighttime routine. This is the perfect balance
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意嘅其中之一。用咗差唔多一年，已經係我晚間護膚程序嘅定番。幫到我收細毛孔，減少咗爆瘡。我用唔到超厚身嘅面霜，但又唔想晚間程序用太輕薄嘅嘢。呢個就係剛剛好嘅平衡。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream 60g
reviews.text: This was a new product for me to try, I've used the Ordinary AHA / BHA mask for a long time and was looking for something on Olive Young I could try with similar effects. I like that this has the qualities of AHA / BHA but isn't something I have to rinse off like the Ordinary one. It's gentler and with that can be used more regularly, but still had phenomenal effects even from one use.
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講係新嘗試嘅產品。我用咗 The Ordinary 嘅 AHA / BHA 面膜好耐，想喺 Olive Young 搵款有類似效果嘅試下。我鍾意呢款有 AHA / BHA 嘅特性，但又唔似 The Ordinary 嗰款要過水。佢溫和啲，所以可以用得更頻密，但就算只係用一次，效果都已經好出色。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream 60g
reviews.text: This is my second bottle. I have very oily skin right now and it’s summer. It’s very light and moisturising and doesn’t make me break out. I feel it inhibits acne development as well which is why I use it for my day time routine
reviews.zh: 已經係我第二枝。我而家皮膚非常油，仲要係夏天。質地好輕、保濕，又唔會令我爆瘡。我覺得佢都幫到手抑制暗瘡形成，所以我日間程序都會用佢。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream 60g
reviews.text: Smell of minty cream, very light on the face and not greasy. It hydrates well
reviews.zh: 薄荷面霜嘅味道，搽上面好輕又唔油笠。保濕效果唔錯。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream 60g
reviews.text: Ésta crema para las imperfecciones, es increíble, ayuda a reducir increíblemente el acné en la piel y cebo regular. En los últimos meses disminuyó demasiado mi acné y no ha generado disminución en la barrera cutánea ni nada.
reviews.zh: 呢款去瑕疵面霜真係好勁，幫到手大幅減少皮膚上嘅暗瘡，同正常咁控制住皮脂。過去幾個月我嘅暗瘡少咗好多，亦都冇損害到皮膚屏障或者任何嘢。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream 60g
reviews.text: This is my third to fourth time repurchasing. Started off using the Some By Mi miracle toner (on my second bottle now) and eventually fell in love with the cream even more. I have dry skin with mild acne around my chin. It gives enough moisture, very lightweight, and just the right level of stickiness as a good base before make up. Highly recommended
reviews.zh: 已經係我第三次至第四次回購喇。一開始用緊 Some By Mi 嘅 miracle toner（依家已經第二枝），後嚟更加愛上咗呢款面霜。我係乾性肌，下巴附近會有少少暗瘡。保濕度足夠，非常輕身，黏笠程度剛剛好，係化妝前一個好好嘅底霜。非常推薦。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
